title: Head of Service Delivery - Finance & Accounts
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Delivery leadership and economics**

* Own end-to-end delivery for all client engagements across service lines and geographies.
* Build and run the delivery operating model: pods or practices, spans of control, and onshore–offshore mix.
* Own delivery cost, engagement margins, utilisation and capacity planning.
* Set and enforce service-level agreements, turnaround times and deliverable calendars for every client.
* Flag scope creep early and work with the CEO on re-pricing or change requests.

**2. Client leadership**

* Act as the senior escalation point and executive sponsor for key accounts.
* Lead periodic business reviews with client promoters, boards and CFO-level stakeholders.
* Ensure each engagement moves beyond transaction processing to insight and advice.
* Drive retention, renewals and expansion of existing mandates into additional service lines.
* Run a structured client feedback process and act on the findings.

**3. Quality, risk and compliance governance**

* Institute a maker–checker–reviewer framework and sign-off protocols for all deliverables.
* Guarantee zero-miss statutory compliance through calendars, trackers and escalation rules.
* Review high-stakes outputs personally: investor models, lender submissions, IPO documents and board packs.
* Maintain engagement risk registers, and manage data confidentiality and information security in delivery.
* Conduct root-cause analysis on every error or delay and close the gap in the process.

**4. Process excellence and technology adoption**

* Deploy and maintain ViTWO's standard operating procedures, RACI matrices and checkpoint libraries across teams.
* Standardise month-end close, payables, receivables, inventory and compliance workflows across clients.
* Champion delivery on the ViTWO.ai platform and drive automation of repetitive work.
* Feed delivery insights back to the product team to shape the ViTWO.ai roadmap.
* Use ViTWO's KPI framework to benchmark clients and internal delivery performance.

**5. People and capability**

* Lead, mentor and grow the delivery organisation, including CAs, CMAs, CS professionals and analysts.
* Build a second line of engagement leaders who can run client relationships independently.
* Own workforce planning, hiring, onboarding and role-based training with HR.
* Set performance goals, conduct reviews and build a culture of ownership and accountability.
* Manage attrition risk and ensure no engagement depends on a single individual.

**6. Transitions and growth support**

* Lead onboarding and transition of new clients, including knowledge transfer and stabilisation.
* Support solutioning, effort estimation and pricing for proposals.
* Establish delivery for international clients, with awareness of local accounting and reporting requirements.
* Work with channel and referral partners on jointly delivered mandates.

**7. Advisory and transaction delivery**

* Oversee execution of debt-raising, VC/PE and capital-market mandates to agreed timelines.
* Coordinate with bankers, investors, merchant bankers, auditors and legal advisers on live transactions.
* Lead finance transformation projects from diagnostic through implementation and handover.

**Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant (essential).
* An additional qualification such as MBA (Finance), CMA, CS, CPA or CFA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of post-qualification experience in finance, with at least 5 years leading multi-client delivery.
* Background in one or more of: a Virtual CFO or F&A outsourcing firm, a Big 4 or large CA firm's outsourcing or advisory practice, a shared-services or global capability centre, or a CFO role in a growth-stage company.
* Has managed a portfolio of concurrent client engagements and a multi-layered team.
* Has owned a delivery budget or P&L, including margin and utilisation.
* Exposure to at least one of debt syndication, VC/PE fundraising or IPO preparation.
* Experience serving overseas clients, particularly in the US, UAE or Australia, is preferred.

**Technical expertise**

* Strong command of Ind AS and Indian GAAP; working knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP is an advantage.
* Sound grasp of Indian direct tax, GST, FEMA, transfer pricing and Companies Act compliance.
* Confident with financial modelling, MIS design, budgeting and business analytics.
* Familiar with audit processes and with what lenders, investors and merchant bankers expect from a finance function.
* Hands-on with ERP systems and comfortable driving automation and AI-enabled finance tools.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Manager Operations - Mutual Fund Accounting
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Manager Operations – Mutual Fund Accounting.**

**In this role, you will:**

* Statutory Reporting team prepares and review Financial Statements comprising of Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account, Cash Flow Statement, Notes on Accounts and other Annexures to Annual or Interim Reports like Statement of Investments, Statement of Changes in Capital etc. for set of Funds administered by Markets and Securities Services globally.
* Performance Reporting Team is responsible for reporting accurate, consistent and timely analysis of all funds under management, including performance measurement, asset allocation, portfolio analysis and risk measures (post Net Asset Value processes). Life Fund Accounting Team is required to provide the provision of monthly reports and data extracts to Insurance clients. The core deliverables include ledger feeds, valuation extracts and supplementary analysis to enable the client to complete statutory accounts and regulatory disclosures. Also required to oversee the entire monthly reporting process
* To manage the Statutory Reporting, Performance Reporting and Life Fund Accounting team in Kolkata and ensure accurate, complete and timely delivery of the outputs. The role can be an individual contributor role or people manager. Responsible for keeping abreast with new pronouncements by various governing and accounting bodies
* Contribute to meeting the cost targets. Managing the process to meet or exceed Service Level Agreement / Performance Level Agreements. Using performance/attribution software, create, quality control and distribute monthly results for all clients to agreed levels, formats and deadlines. Update monthly fund benchmarks and keeping abreast of market and index developments. Carry out post month end control checks for Life & Insurance clients within agreed service levels and to a high standard of accuracy.
* Provide ledger feeds, valuation extracts and supplementary analysis to enable the client to complete statutory accounts and regulatory disclosures. Review all investment accounting reports required by the client to support the general ledger feed. Oversee the entire monthly reporting process. Ongoing resource management to minimize, impact of attrition. Continuous monitoring of production calendar to meet Business Needs. Management Information’s are provided timely and accurately.
* Review and authorize all investment accounting reports produced. All Key Performance Indicators, accuracy targets and Service Level Agreements are met. Engagement with Business Areas to understand and work on improving customer satisfaction. Proactively identify and improve service delivery. Driving key streamlining initiatives. Effective resource allocation and management

* Review progress of team members and provide necessary training and support. Adherence to the Group’s agreed processes / procedures – achieving a satisfactory Audit report. Regularly review operational effectiveness and regularly review procedures. Updating all daily MIS (Management Information System) / trackers as required by the process. Ensure timely follow up on the open & outstanding issues that hinder the valuation. Ensure, Escalation Matrix is followed as per agreed between Business Partners and Markets and Securities Services Kolkata.
* Undertake/participate in projects for improvement in delivery quality and/or timeliness. Identify and reduce manual processes for enhanced operational control. Support and implement technology upgradation. Continually raising the risks that have been identified / observed in department processes and procedures. Support audit process and recommendations on a timely manner. Perform the fund’s activities correctly as per the Standard Operating Procedures, Checklist and controls.

**To be successful, you will:**

* Commerce graduate or post-graduate with relevant working experience.
* Professional qualification in the fields of Accounting like CA (Chartered Accountant), ICWA (Institute of Cost and Works Accountants), CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) and CS (Company Secretary) with relevant working experience.
* 5+ Years of experience in fund accounting, Net Asset Value, Gross Asset Value and Mutual Funds.
* Strong Accounting Concepts with a clear understanding of financial statements. Sound knowledge of various types of assets, Funds Administration and accounting services and understanding of valuations cycle, financial instruments, corporate actions and accounting concepts.
* Understanding of the Accounting Standards and the ability to relate them to the disclosures in the Financial Statements. Exposure to IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) and US GAAP (United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) will be desirable. Knowledge of types of Performance Reporting and calculations employed in the industry.

* An understanding of investment instruments and how they are processed for performance calculation purposes is required. Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word skills. IOC (Investment Operations Certificate) / CISI (Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment) certification would be an added advantage.
* Understanding of Cash reconciliation, Income and Expense would be an added advantage. Knowledge of Bloomberg, Reuters and relevant data feeds would be added advantage. Should have an eye for detail and a strong analytical mind.
* Efficient Time Management and ability to multi task work and prioritize to meet defined deadlines. Should be able to communicate effectively with overseas customers and employees. Proactive in accomplishing tasks without being asked to do so.

description:

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Manager Operations - Traditional Fund Accounting.**

**In this role, you will:**

* The traditional Accounting & Valuations team has daily, monthly and weekly Net Asset Value valuations with stringent timelines. The team is responsible for performing capital activity bookings, accruals, amortization, yields leading to final generation and validation of Net Asset Value through diagnostic checks, Financial Mainframe Report and post Net Asset Value activities. The team also performs other Monthly & Reporting activities which includes Fee Reviews. Ex‑Dividend Distribution, Trustee Packs and Queries, Regulatory & Client Reporting. The Accounting & Valuations team is responsible functionally across multiple jurisdictions (where applicable) serviced out of Markets and Securities Services Kolkata.
* The role will require technical excellence to achieve target deliverables combined with the ability to get work done from administrators and / or Subject Matter Expert to achieve target Key Performance Indicator. The role will demand a daily balance of delivering excellent client service within the standard Net Asset Value model of promoting continuous improvement of Net Asset Value processes and of identifying and capitalizing opportunities to create capacity and generate efficiencies.
* Responsible for identifying and reducing manual processes for enhanced operational control. Undertake relevant measures to extend support and implementation of technology upgradation. Lead and oversee User Acceptance Testing for the business (as and when required) initiatives.
* Lead Projects for both business partners and Markets and Securities Services Kolkata (based on business objectives, targets and requirements). To acquire a comprehensive and broad understanding of the Traditional Net Asset Value processes and to keep abreast of the latest developments in the assigned markets on the rules and regulations by the regulators, stock exchange and etc. that may have implication to the daily Net Asset Value processes.
* This role includes the responsibility to ensure that business data requirements are completed accurately and efficiently, additionally make sure that supporting statistics/reports/returns are presented to business/management within agreed timescales. Drive the plan for standardization of processes by sharing the best practices across the various markets with the aim of enhancing cost effectiveness and efficiency.

* To ensure control measures/checkpoints are established to scrutinize exceptions/errors to prevent any operational losses and reviews on these measures are constantly performed. Procedural changes/new initiatives are reviewed, fully communicated to and implemented.
* Review Contingency requirements on a periodic basis and invoke relevant business recovery measures as necessary. Carry out effective Operational Risk Assessment by monitoring and implementing risk mitigating plans. Maintains HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
* Ensure Gross Asset Value / Net Asset Value operating procedure is followed with management of risks (if any). Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures. Ensure governance on all daily/weekly tracker updated by team. Update all management MI by the stipulated deadlines. Additional review of Job-Aid Matrix, Standard Operating Procedure, process notes, checklists and other internal process related documents periodically.

**To be successful, you will:**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or qualifications in the accounting/finance industry. Strong working knowledge on Microsoft Office.
* Overall 5+ Years of experience and 3-5 years of relevant Funds administration experience. Excellent knowledge of Capital Markets and Financial instruments. Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting. Excellent knowledge in Net Asset Value Calculation process with clear understanding of the End-to-End Fund Accounting Model.
* Ability to monitor and meet operational goals. Should have an eye for detail and a strong analytical mind. Ability to update, manage and analyze Management Information related activities. Evidence of good analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends and make projections. Production management skills and ability to initiate process improvements and recognize areas for development.
* Complete understanding of Trade Life Cycle. Understanding of Gross Asset Value - Net Asset Value Activities. Previous experience in performing & reviewing funds in Accounting & Valuations. Knowledge in investment accounting, investment valuations, fund industry. Working knowledge on IMS, Multifonds, ICON, Bloomberg, etc. Knowledge in the use of Bloomberg and/or Reuters.

* Ability to speak and understand English fluently, writes business letters and reports, good conversational / telephone skills. Ability to learn quickly, transfers knowledge appropriately, understand and interpret numeric data. Evidence of good analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends and make projections. Production management skills and ability to initiate process improvements.
* Initiate cost control measures by achieving resource efficiency and managing overheads. Evidence of very good prioritizing, planning and organizing skills. Ability to effectively communicate and implement group policies and procedures
* Ability to comprehend and minimize operational risks including wide understanding of audit controls and compliance requirements. Ability to maintain control, direction and motivation of staff in an ever-changing environment. Proven experience in change and problem-solving management.
* Strong Accounting Concepts with a clear understanding of financial statements. Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds and reconciliations.

title: Fundraiser
description:
**Fundraising & Investor Relations Associate**

Maverick Drones and Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

*Full-time | Kolkata, West Bengal | ₹6–7.2 LPA + success-linked incentives*

About Us

Maverick Drones and Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian drone technology company focused on the design, development, manufacturing, integration, and deployment of unmanned aerial systems for defense, aerospace, industrial, infrastructure, and commercial applications. As we continue to expand our business and strengthen our presence in the drone and defense technology ecosystem, we are looking for a driven professional to support our investor relations and fundraising initiatives.

The Role

We are looking for a Fundraising & Investor Relations Associate who can identify relevant investors, establish meaningful connections, initiate conversations, and secure qualified meetings with potential investment partners. The individual will work directly with the CEO and take ownership of the investor outreach process, enabling the leadership team to focus on strategic discussions and investment opportunities.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how investment networks work and is confident in engaging with venture capital funds, family offices, private investment firms, HNIs, UHNIs, and strategic investors.

Key ResponsibilitiesInvestor identification and research

● Identify and build a pipeline of venture capital funds, family offices, private investment firms, HNIs, UHNIs, and strategic investors.

● Research investors specializing in defense, aerospace, drones, robotics, deep tech, advanced manufacturing, and dual-use technologies.

● Identify relevant fund managers, partners, investment directors, and other decision-makers.

● Assess investor mandates, investment preferences, sector focus, and portfolio fit.

Investor outreach and networking

● Proactively approach investors through professional email, LinkedIn, telephone, industry networks, and referrals.

● Introduce Maverick Drones and communicate its business proposition using approved investor materials.

● Build and maintain a pipeline of potential investors and develop long-term professional relationships.

● Follow up consistently and convert initial outreach into meaningful investor conversations and meetings.

Fundraising execution

● Schedule and coordinate investor meetings directly with the CEO.

● Manage investor communication from initial outreach through follow-ups, meetings, and subsequent discussions.

● Maintain an organized investor database and track interactions, responses, and next steps.

● Coordinate investor information requests and due-diligence activities with internal teams.

● Provide regular updates on investor engagement, pipeline progress, and upcoming meetings.

Investor relations and transaction support

● Assist in preparing pitch decks, company profiles, investor presentations, and supporting financial information.

● Conduct preliminary industry, market, and comparable-company research where required.

● Coordinate with external advisers, investment bankers, and other fundraising intermediaries.

● Identify relevant networking events, investment forums, and strategic opportunities to expand the company's investor network.

Who We’re Looking For

**Practical investment exposure matters more than academic credentials.**

We are particularly interested in candidates who have practical exposure to investment banking, venture capital, private equity, startup fundraising, investor relations, or financial advisory.

Preferred qualifications and experience

● Approximately 1–4 years of relevant professional experience.

● Demonstrated exposure to investor outreach, fundraising, deal sourcing, investment research, or financial advisory.

● Candidates with established professional networks among investors or investment professionals will have an advantage.

● An MBA in Finance, CFA qualification, or other relevant financial qualification is desirable but not mandatory.

● Strong candidates with a bachelor's degree and relevant practical experience are encouraged to apply.

Essential skills

● Excellent communication, networking, and relationship-building abilities.

● Confidence in approaching senior professionals, fund managers, and investment decision-makers.

● Strong professional email writing, presentation, and follow-up skills.

● Ability to research investors and identify suitable investment opportunities.

● Familiarity with Excel, PowerPoint, LinkedIn, and investor research tools.

● Basic understanding of corporate finance, equity investments, valuation, and fundraising processes.

● A proactive, persistent, and results-oriented approach to work.

What Matters Most in This Role?

We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is financial modelling or reporting alone. We want someone who can find the right investors, reach the right decision-makers, initiate conversations, build relationships, and get qualified meetings scheduled with the CEO.

Candidates who can demonstrate real investor access, networking ability, and fundraising execution skills will be given preference over candidates who possess academic qualifications without relevant practical exposure.

Compensation and Incentives

● Fixed annual compensation: ₹6–7.2 LPA.

● Performance incentive: Highly attractive, success-linked incentives upon successful completion of investment transactions.

● Location: Kolkata, West Bengal.

● Employment type: Full-time.

● Reporting to: CEO.

**Attractive Success-Linked Incentives:** In addition to the fixed annual compensation, the role offers highly lucrative incentives linked to successful investment transactions. We believe in rewarding meaningful contributions to the company's growth, and the right candidate can expect significant upside for successfully facilitating investment opportunities.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹55,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund
